selection: Bounded three economic candidates; provisional systems test values, not finished product economy
rules: Eligible kill reward points multiply by current 1+1.5*HarvestLevel; no past-kill change, no child points, no ink/attack multiplier
metaCostCaveat: Initial Damage cost8 grows by1.48^level, rounded up. Ratio is cost units, not count of affordable levels. No long-term meta economy or retention validation.
validationDistinction: Seeds11..20 were evaluated for every candidate, not untouched holdout. Seeds21..30 were first run after candidate2 was fixed; failures did not trigger further tuning.
limitations: Same10seeds reused across6 weapons, not60 independent seeds
The16x cap is large and accelerates permanent upgrades; economic inflation remains unvalidated
No hidden build-label multiplier; manual players can buy Harvest
No crystal points for split children; no reroll/seed selection
No Unity execution or hardware performance claim
